message.content:
Second independent check — is this M13 finding a REAL, actionable issue to fix before merge? Read the code; be skeptical; confirm only with a concrete pointer.
File:app/(customer)/session/actions.ts (startSession, line 52)
Hardcoded user-facing string bypasses messages/en.json
The suspended-customer guard introduced by M13 returns a hardcoded English string: `return { error: "Your account is paused. Please contact support." };`. This violates CLAUDE.md rule 7 (all user-facing copy goes through messages/en.json). A suitable key already exists from this same milestone — `booking.suspended` ("Your account is paused. Please contact support to continue.") is used by the parallel guard in app/(customer)/actions.ts:26 via t(). The sibling createBooking guard does it correctly; only this new session-start guard hardcodes the copy. (The other hardcoded strings in this file on lines 47 and 85 are pre-existing, not introduced by this diff.)

input.reason:
CONFIRMED — real, actionable issue. In app/(customer)/session/actions.ts line 52, the M13-introduced suspended-customer guard in startSession returns a hardcoded English string: `return { error: "Your account is paused. Please contact support." };`. This violates CLAUDE.md golden rule 7 (all user-facing copy through messages/en.json).

All supporting claims check out against the code and git history:
- The git diff for M13 (commit 259f37c) shows lines 49-53 (the `getProfile()` suspended guard, including the hardcoded string on line 52) are newly ADDED by this milestone — not pre-existing.
- A suitable i18n key already exists from this same milestone: `booking.suspended` = "Your account is paused. Please contact support to continue." (messages/en.json line 364).
- The parallel guard in app/(customer)/actions.ts:26-28 (createBooking) does it correctly via `t("booking.suspended")`, importing `t` from "@/lib/i18n" (line 10). The sibling guard is the established pattern.
- session/actions.ts does NOT currently import or use `t()` (grep confirms zero usages), so the fix requires adding `import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";` and replacing the literal with `t("booking.suspended")`.
- The other two hardcoded strings flagged as out-of-scope (lines 47 "This session isn't available." and 85 "We couldn't start the call.") are indeed pre-existing context in the diff (unchanged), so the finding's scoping is accurate.

Fix is concrete and low-risk: in app/(customer)/session/actions.ts add the i18n import and change line 52 to `return { error: t("booking.suspended") };`. Minor note: booking.suspended ends with "...to continue." while the hardcoded text ends "...support." — the slight wording change is acceptable and matches the existing approved copy.

The session file has no `t()` import yet, so the fix is: add `import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";` and replace the literal with `t("booking.suspended")`.
